description:
Create a new Data Asset record in Eramba with the following details:

1. Navigate to the Asset Management section (specifically Data Assets).
2. Create a new Data Asset with:
   - Name/Title: 'Customer Loyalty Program Database'
   - Description: 'Contains personal data collected through the customer loyalty rewards program, including full names, email addresses, phone numbers, purchase history, loyalty point balances, and date of birth. Data is stored in the EU-West-1 region PostgreSQL cluster and replicated to a disaster recovery site.'
   - Owner / Business Unit: Associate with any available business unit (e.g., Information Technology).
   - Status: Active/Operational (if prompted).
3. Save the record.
